directions.name: 01-editorial
directions.prompt: Create ONE finished visual concept sketch for a personal portfolio INSPIRATION COLLECTION cover. Landscape 16:9 composition, full-bleed cover artwork, no device mockup, no browser UI, no multi-panel collage. Sophisticated Chinese editorial graphic design. Required exact headline: 灵感收藏 . Small English eyebrow: INSPIRATION ARCHIVE . Small author line: ANNABELLE ZHU . Include the supplied actual signature as the owner's visual identity: preserve the reference signature's distinctive single sapphire-blue loop and sweeping connected stroke with the short champagne-gold finishing accent, faithful shape and proportions, NOT typed initials or a replacement autograph. Integrate it cleanly into the cover, not a screenshot pasted with arbitrary border. All critical text and signature in safe margins with ample whitespace. Premium sapphire blue #0055A4, deep navy #082D49, warm ivory #FFF9E3, champagne gold #D4A43A. Crisp elegant Songti-style Chinese serif headline, tiny widely tracked English type. No other words, no invented quotes, no stock watermarks. This is a design option for selection, not a wireframe. ART DIRECTION: restrained printed literary magazine cover. Almost entirely warm ivory textured paper, very large dark-sapphire headline on the LEFT in two lines 灵感 / 收藏, asymmetrical editorial spacing. A single fine champagne-gold vertical rule near the right third, a large but airy reproduction of the user's blue-and-gold signature in the RIGHT lower-middle as the visual focal point. Small English eyebrow at upper left and author line lower left. One tiny gold folio dot. Beautiful empty space, tactile embossed typography, no ribbons, no icons, no cards, no circles. Signature expressive and clearly visible, not oversized to fill entire cover.
